decisions.reason: Builds directly on the firm's established supplement knowledge, giving strong absorptive capacity to interpret results and improve the product, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
Closely related to existing supplement capabilities and with a clear value proposition, the firm can learn from early signals and refine it, making a drop unlikely.

Although mushroom-based is more novel, it still leverages supplement formulation and quality control capabilities, and the firm has had time to build related knowledge, so it is likely kept under monitoring.
Distant from the firm's established offer, it lacks related knowledge to interpret early results and improve the product, so absorptive capacity is low and withdrawal is probable.
